test_name: Linear Algebra Practice Test - Part C

questions.text: Let \(A\) be a \(3 \times 3\) matrix with eigenvalues 1, -1, and 3. Let \(B = A^2 + 2I\), where \(I\) is the \(3 \times 3\) identity matrix. Compute the determinant of \(B\).
Let \(A\) be a \(5 \times 5\) real matrix defined by \(A_{ij} = i + j\) for all \(1 \le i, j \le 5\). What is the rank of the matrix \(A\)?
Let \(J\) be a \(10 \times 10\) matrix where every entry is 1, and let \(I\) be the \(10 \times 10\) identity matrix. Compute the determinant of the matrix \(A = I + J\).
Let \(A\) be a \(4 \times 4\) real matrix such that \(A^3 = I\) but \(A \ne I\). If \(A\) has exactly two real eigenvalues (counting multiplicities), compute the trace of \(A\).

Consider the vector space \(V\) of all real polynomials of degree at most 3. Let \(T: V \to V\) be the linear transformation defined by \(T(p(x)) = x p'(x) + p''(x)\). What is the trace of the matrix representation of \(T\) with respect to any basis of \(V\)?
